en.headline: Former lawmaker William Wong sentenced to community service over CUHK drink-driving crash
en.dek: Sha Tin Court ordered 120 hours of community service, a one-year driving ban and a HK$6,000 fine after Wong pleaded guilty to four traffic offences.
body: Former Legislative Council member William Wong Kam-fai was sentenced on Thursday to 120 hours of community service, a one-year disqualification from driving and a total fine of HK$6,000 for drink-driving and related offences stemming from a hit-and-run at the Chinese University of Hong Kong.

The 66-year-old pleaded guilty to driving with alcohol concentration above the prescribed limit, careless driving, failing to stop after an accident and failing to report an accident. The incident occurred late on 29 June when Wong’s private car collided with two parked vehicles on the university campus.

A breathalyser test recorded a level more than double the statutory limit. Wong, who resigned from LegCo and stepped down from his university post shortly after the incident, must also complete a driving improvement course at his own expense.
The magistrate noted the professional consequences already faced by the defendant, including the loss of his elected office and academic role.

zh.headline: 前立法會議員黃錦輝中大醉駕撞車被判120小時社會服務令
zh.dek: 沙田裁判法院周四判處黃錦輝120小時社會服務令、停牌一年及罰款共6000元，他早前承認四項交通罪行。
body: 前立法會議員黃錦輝周四在沙田裁判法院被判處120小時社會服務令、停牌一年及合共罰款6000元，案情涉及今年6月在中文大學校園醉駕後撞及停泊車輛並離開現場。
66歲的黃錦輝承認酒精濃度超標駕駛、不小心駕駛、意外後不停車及沒有報案四項控罪。事發於6月29日深夜，他的私家車在校園內碰撞兩部停泊車輛。
警方當時的呼氣測試顯示其酒精含量超過法定限額一倍以上。黃錦輝事後辭去立法會席位及大學職務，法院亦命令他自費完成駕駛改進課程。
裁判官考慮到被告已承受嚴重的專業後果，包括失去民選職位及學術職務。
